'''Ebya T'dell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around [[4992 BBY]]. She was the daughter of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Nafjan T'dell|Nafjan]] and [[Kanika T'dell]], who were crewmembers of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] ''[[Omen]]'' when it crashed on Kesh in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. In [[4985 BBY]], when just seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, T'dell was examined by prominent Sith [[Seelah Korsin]], to determine whether she would be able to have a family in the stringent Sith [[Lost Tribe of Sith|society]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is Ebya T'dell, daughter of the miner Nafjan and the bridge cadet Kanika. Eight years old next month by our counting. No ailments.|[[Orlenda]], Seelah Korsin's assistant|<ref name="paragon" />}}
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] around [[4992 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Ebya T'dell was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was the daughter of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] crewmembers of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]''&mdash;[[Nafjan T'dell|Nafjan]] and [[Kanika T'dell]]&mdash;who had survived the<ref name="paragon" /> [[Sith dreadnaught]]'s<ref name="crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> crash on Kesh eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|earlier]]. In [[4985 BBY]], T'dell was sent to be examined by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Seelah Korsin]], who was to determine whether she would be allowed to reproduce in the new Keshiri [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith society]]. T'dell was closely examined by Korsin, an acquaintance of her [[Parent/Legends|parents]], who noted her high [[Bone/Legends|cheekbones]] and expressed concern at the child's "florid" [[Color/Legends|coloring]]. Ultimately, Korsin determined that T'dell might be allowed to have a family, if the proper partner was found. Momentarily safe in the knowledge that she might not be a genetic dead-end, T'dell left to play outdoors.<ref name="paragon" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And what is your duty?''"<br />"''To be like you, milady.''"<br />"''Not the answer I had in mind, but I won't argue.|Seelah Korsin and Ebya T'dell|<ref name="paragon" />}}
Ebya T'dell was a stern-faced child in good physical health, who was respectful and obedient toward the leaders of the Sith on Kesh, such as Seelah Korsin. Although only seven years old in 4,985 BBY, T'dell knew that she wanted to have a family, and was relieved when it was not ruled out for her when she was examined by Korsin. She believed that her duty as a Sith was to be like Korsin, a point T'dell's examiner did not want to argue.<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ebya T'dell appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
